propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must delegate to core push entrypoints with no inline CAS loops or raw-git retry logic remaining in YAML
Reconciler workflow must execute one strict synchronous commit-and-push core action preserving bot identity and commit subject, remaining red on exhausted delivery failure
Canary workflow must execute one strict synchronous push-only core action via rebar._store.push with CAS recovery owned by core
Python library and MCP push defaults retain best-effort behavior; only strict workflow CLI adapters change to synchronous delivery
Raw-git reconciler exemption must be removed and test rationale replaced with generic reviewed-fixture wording
Real-git workflow smoke tests must validate successful delivery, rejected-push red failure, and local commit recovery on rejection
